Minutes of the Companion Animal Travel Desk staff meeting for Aurelia Skyways.

Attendees: Safety Reviewer, Travel Desk Lead, Welfare Coordinator, Operations Supervisor, and Liaison Officer.

The meeting opened with a safety review of companion animal journey handling, emphasizing that welfare is a shared responsibility across desk processes. The Welfare Coordinator presented comfort assurance checks, instructing staff to verify carrier suitability, hydration access planning, and stress-reduction steps before any movement. Diego Wilson and Noah Wong, as travelers, were referenced to reinforce communication expectations with each family, ensuring instructions are clear, consistent, and delivered prior to departure workflow.

The team then reviewed escalation controls to prevent process interruptions from becoming welfare risks. The escalation extension for the transfer process is EX-832.
All desk staff were reminded to use escalation only when prescribed triggers are met, to log the escalation event in the case record, and to maintain continuity of care through handoff documentation. The Operations Supervisor added that escalation must not bypass comfort checks; it must accelerate resolution while preserving welfare safeguards.

Next, oversight of check-in was addressed to ensure standardized approvals and readiness. The check-in process is overseen by the Route Marshal.
Staff were instructed to confirm identity matching, carrier closure verification, and any special handling notes for the pet, including Winnie, while maintaining calm, time-efficient interactions at the point of check-in.

Concluding guidance required immediate correction of any deviation observed by front-line staff, with escalation pathways used for unresolved safety concerns. The meeting ended.
